messages:
jin: quick heads-up — vuln triage (TKT-7881) needs full decoded logs for 2025-02-02..2025-02-03. current ephemeral_30d auto-delete will lose context. can we get a scoped 90d exception?

sara: thanks. i think we should create a timeboxed snapshot with tag `triage_90d` and a locked escrow path if legal escalation happens. snapshot TTL 90d by default.

mike: ok RBAC Q: who can request/create `triage_90d` snapshots? we need least-privilege role and an approver chain. propose roles: `requester: security-analyst`, `creator: export-service`, `approver: sec-sr`

elaine: compliance: add `legal_hold` flag to prevent auto-delete and require `legal` approval. audit trail must include CMK unwrap events and the requestor's org role. also we require immutable retention metadata on the object.

forensics-bot: note: export-service will emit events: `export.requested`, `export.completed`, `export.escrowed`, `kms.unwrap_attempt` to `audit.logs`. Ensure those indices are retained.

mike: implementers: exporter should enforce OPA policy: allow if requester in `security-analyst` AND approver role present. if `legal_hold=true` then escrow flow triggered and CMK unwrap requires 2 approvers (sec-sr + legal).

jin: what about partner access for triage (vendor needs 48h access)? i prefer a redacted view or ephemeral role `vendor-limited` with no unwrap rights.

sara: agreed. vendor access = redacted view only. raw exports go only through `security-escrow` escalation and legal vetting. SAS links disabled by default; can be allowed with `partner_sla=true` and legal sign-off.

elaine: add `justification_hash` to exports so we can link to ticket + evidence. also log the approving principal id but mask PII in the audit index unless legal_flag.

mike: draft export_request payload ill put in PR (small example):

```
{"range":"2025-02-02T00:00Z/2025-02-03T23:59Z","tag":"triage_90d","requester":"jin","approver":"sec-sr","legal_hold":false,"justification_hash":"sha256:...","share_mode":"redacted_view"}
```

jin: perfect. two more: 1) ensure exporter writes a provenance header with source cluster + node id, 2) ensure KMS-proxy emits truncated principal id in audit.

forensics-bot: reminder: JIT unmasking policy applies. sensitivity=high requires 2 approvers and will create a `unmask.record` in audit.logs.

legal: legal here  we will accept `legal_hold` via ticket with POA attached. if POA present, escrowed objects will be retained until release.

sara: action items: mike -> PR for exporter OPA + audit events (ETA 2d); jin -> update triage runbook + ticket template; elaine -> compliance checklist + legal meeting; legal -> confirm POA checklist by EOD Wed. planning deploy tag mapping Wed EOD. ack here when done. :white_check_mark:
